findings.body: Raise: Functional. `review_ref` prefers an existing `origin/<branch>` over `headRefOid` even when that remote ref is stale. `forge next` does not fetch before checking readiness. After another machine pushes a commit, a matching receipt for the old commit can still make `forge next` report the item ready while GitHub reports the newer head.
findings.title: Not done: readiness must use the current pull request head

findings.body: Raise: Functional. A fetched PR head can be ready through the shared record while this machine's worktree is behind it. The `HEAD == receipt['commit']` condition skips `forge close`, then the agent-merge path offers `forge merge`. That command requires a matching local receipt and refuses, so the recommended next step cannot complete.
findings.title: Not done: shared readiness needs a valid next step when the worktree is behind

findings.body: Raise: Not done. `approved` accepts an approval from any historical copy without checking it against the current plan. If an approved plan is edited above `## For the builders`, `forge next` requires another read and approval, but this code still counts the story as building or approved, not started. The board's state and counts then disagree with the approval gate.
findings.title: Not done: changed plans must lose their approved story count

findings.body: Raise: Not done. The new `review_ref` is used for readiness only. The board still builds findings and review status from its selected state copy (`board.py` lines 305–309 and 448), while `forge next` reads the worktree state in `_task` (`nextstep.py` line 598). After a second machine pushes a newer reviewed commit, a machine with an older worktree can show the old findings and round while another shows the PR head's history.
findings.title: Not done: read review history from the selected review ref

findings.body: Raise: Scale. `_prs` reads the cached weekly searches here, then makes another `gh pr list --state merged --limit 25` call at `board.py` line 878 on every HTML board run. The guide promises pull request lists at most once a minute, but repeatedly opening the page always makes this ninth, uncached list call.
findings.title: Cache the HTML board's additional merged pull request list

findings.body: Raise: Gate. This branch changes `docs/specs/agent-merge.read.md`, which is outside COUNTS' Scope and is not needed for shared counts, readiness, caching, or their tests. The edit also removes that separate spec read's `amended_hash`.
findings.title: Scope: unrelated agent-merge read record changed

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The supplied proof list names `[counts]`, `[github-once]`, and `[approved-not-started]`, but this test also parametrizes `previous`, so none is an actual pytest node ID. The cases have IDs that include `new-client` or `earlier-adoption`; the recorded proof selectors therefore do not identify runnable tests.
findings.title: Not done: proof list
